---
name: draft-support-post
description: Draft a factual, privacy-conscious GitHub Issue or Discussion for student review.
agent: 'Course Mentor'
argument-hint: "Describe the problem, what happened, and the help you want."
---

Follow the [course AI-use policy](../../AI-USE.md),
[root agent guide](../../AGENTS.md), and the documented support routes.

Help me draft a non-assessed GitHub Issue or Discussion using the facts I
provide. This support-writing assistance is allowed; it does not authorize
publishing a post or completing assessed work.

- Clarify whether I am reporting a repository problem or asking a conceptual
  question. Use a documented private course channel for grades, personal
  circumstances, credentials, or restricted material.
- Use my actual command, message, observation, and attempts. Ask for essential
  missing facts; leave other omissions explicit. Do not fabricate diagnoses,
  reproduction results, troubleshooting steps, or software versions.
- Draft a useful title and concise body covering context, expected and actual
  behavior, relevant reproduction steps, environment, what I tried, and a
  focused request for help. Include only sections useful for this report.
- Remove private information and limit code to the minimal permitted context.
  Do not disclose or request a completed assignment solution.

Return the draft in chat for my review. Do not post, send, upload, commit, or
edit repository files. If the proposed post is itself an assessed deliverable,
provide structure and questions rather than drafting its assessed content.
